data.one_liner: A customisable TextField widget to display and input PIN codes in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: PinInputTextField provides a specialized text field widget designed for PIN codes and OTP inputs. It supports customized shapes, multiple built-in styles such as underlines and boxes, obscuring text, and form validation integration.
use_when: You need to build a PIN or OTP verification screen.
You require specific styling like underlined or boxed character segments.
avoid_when: You need a standard single-line text input field.
You are using a Flutter version below 3.7.0 (requires 4.4.1 or lower for older versions).
strengths: Pure Dart with no extra dependencies.
Supports multiple built-in pin styles like UnderlineDecoration, BoxLooseDecoration, BoxTightDecoration, and CircleDecoration.
Supports all platforms supported by Flutter.
weaknesses: The PinEditingController listener may execute more than once when programmatically setting text.
Some onSubmit callbacks might not work consistently on Android.
